page.text:
The axiom of extensionality fixes what it means for two sets to be equal:
a set is completely determined by its members. Not the way it was
described, not the order of its elements, and not any repetition -- only
membership counts. This is what lets us speak of *the* empty set or *the*
union of two sets.
